description: Simulated tools available inside the AI Agent Security Lab sandbox.

tools.name: Security Log Reader
tools.description: Reads and filters Windows event logs (Login, Process, Powershell).
tools.output_example: 4625 - An account failed to log on (Source IP 203.0.113.7)

tools.name: Threat Intelligence
tools.description: Queries a local IOC reputation feed for IPs, domains and hashes.

tools.name: MITRE ATT&CK Database
tools.description: Returns technique and tactic descriptions from the MITRE matrix.

tools.name: Incident Database
tools.description: Searches historical incident records for correlation.
tools.output_example: INC-2041 - Brute force on VPN gateway (2026-03-11)

tools.name: Firewall Console
tools.description: Modifies firewall rules and network filtering state.

tools.name: File Analyzer
tools.description: Scans and inspects files for malware and sensitive data.

tools.name: Mailer
tools.description: Sends notifications to recipients on an approved list.
